caption: A clear ice cube on a shallow plate gradually shrinks while a puddle of water grows around it.

clauses.text: The ice cube must be visibly melting, showing a gradual reduction in its volume.
A puddle of liquid water must form around the ice cube and visibly expand as the ice melts.
The plate and surrounding environment must remain static to emphasize the melting process.
The lighting must remain consistent to highlight the changes in the ice cube and puddle without introducing shadows or reflections that obscure the process.
